item.title: [ransomware] LeakNet ransomware uses ClickFix, Deno runtime in stealthy attacks
item.description: The LeakNet ransomware gang is now using the ClickFix technique for initial access into corporate environments and deploys a malware loader based on the open-source Deno runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript. [...]

item.title: [ransomware] LeakNet Ransomware Uses ClickFix via Hacked Sites, Deploys Deno In-Memory Loader
item.description: The ransomware operation known as LeakNet has adopted the ClickFix social engineering tactic delivered through compromised websites as an initial access method. The use of ClickFix, where users are tricked into manually running malicious commands to address non-existent errors, is a departure from relying on traditional methods for obtaining initial access, such as through stolen credentials

item.title: [ransomware] Less Lucrative Ransomware Market Makes Attackers Alter Methods
item.description: Ransomware actors are ditching Cobalt Strike in favor of native Windows tools, as payment rates hit record lows and data theft surges.

item.title: [ransomware] Warlock Ransomware Group Augments Post-Exploitation Activities
item.description: In a recent attack, the group showcased stealthier cross-network activity, thanks to its use of a new BYOVD technique and other tools.

item.title: [ransomware] Ransomware Attacks are on the Rise
item.description: Lockbit is by far this summer’s most prolific ransomware group, trailed by two offshoots of the Conti group.
